stories.title: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead

sources.title: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead
sources.title_en: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead
sources.title_original: Thieves steal Nvidia-labeled trailers expecting massive AI GPU payday, but score 40,000 pounds of sand instead
sources.summary: The two PlusAI trailers with Nvidia-partner markings were apparently left outside the startup's warehouse, making it a juicy target for criminals looking to make easy money on AI GPUs. However, they were deliberately left outside as the trailers only contained sand for simulating real-world truck loads.

stories.title: Linux 爱好者看到 10 秒的内核编译时间即将到来 / Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon

sources.title: Linux 爱好者看到 10 秒的内核编译时间即将到来 / Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
sources.title_zh: Linux 爱好者看到 10 秒的内核编译时间即将到来
sources.title_en: Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
sources.title_original: Linux enthusiasts see 10-second kernel compilation times on the horizon
sources.summary: It won’t be long until Linux enthusiasts will be able to complete a clean kernel build in under 10 seconds thanks to advances in PC hardware and the AI-assisted optimization of compilers.
sources.summary_zh: 得益于 PC 硬件的进步和编译器的 AI 辅助优化，不久之后 Linux 爱好者将能够在 10 秒内完成干净的内核构建。
